It forms part of the analytical framework combining the triad of states that are accompanied by visible form and reacting (or their opposites, *Sanidassanattika*) with the dyadic categories beginning with grasping or clinging (*Upādānadukādi*), methodically examining their conditioned relationships according to canonical causal conditioning schemes [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
